revision.content:
# Design Comparison of Project Alpha and Project Beta

## Storage Mechanisms

Project Alpha uses SQLite for storage and has a capacity of 37 litres. [E1, E2]

> Project Beta stores 92 litres. Beta uses append-only log files. Beta permits writes on Sundays. Backups run twice a day. [E3, E4]

## Sunday Write Operations

Project Alpha stops writing on Sundays, whereas Project Beta permits writes on Sundays. [E5, E6]

## Backup Strategies

Project Alpha performs a backup once per day, while Project Beta runs backups twice a day. [E7, E8]

## Source and coverage report
